title: Native UI test selector should reject an empty CTest match
body: The queued UI guard command used an empty selector and exited 0 without running tests or printing a summary, so it was initially unusable as evidence. Recovery used a verified regex selecting UiHitMask, HudSmokeTest, UiCompositionHostTest, UiKitRule, UiKitContract, UiKitTest, HudViewTest, and ViewHudGolden.IViewSeamIsViewAgnostic and observed 39/39 passes. Make the native test helper fail or report an explicit zero-test result when a selector matches nothing, so a green no-op cannot masquerade as a witness.
